profiles.description: Taste-neutral fallback when no specialized viewer outcome is justified; the exact approved brief supplies all creative priorities.
Product or brand campaign communication whose primary outcome is attention, message recall, consideration, or action rather than complete workflow understanding.
Builds a causally accurate mental model of a technical system, architecture, mechanism, interface, state change, or engineering process.
Builds transferable intuition about a concept or phenomenon so the viewer can explain it and recognize or apply it in a nearby example.
Short narration-led explanation specifically communicated through coordinated simple illustrations, concise headline text, and speech-following captions.
Makes a target viewer able to complete a task correctly, recognize important state changes, and handle relevant prerequisites or branches.
Proves product value through observable behavior in a concrete user job: initial state, action, response, result, and resulting value.
Builds a credible audience-specific argument for an idea, proposal, project, strategy, decision, or ask.
Uses story progression, changed state, stakes, discovery, supported causal relationships, emotion, or thematic payoff as the primary communication mechanism.
Helps viewers accurately understand data findings, comparisons, trends, context, uncertainty, limitations, and supported conclusions.
Turns an instructor's lecture deck and approved voice-over into a video students can follow and review: faithful to the approved narration and deck facts, with each idea's structure made visible.
